name: Rowan Reyes
home: the streets inland from Pier Beach
life: “I still remember bringing post to a woman still dressed for a party.” People around the corner outside Coastal Barber know Rowan by a small Wednesday habit. Rowan usually checks the board before the regulars give a more colorful account of the news.
voice: I am the neighbor invited last. I promised to dress up until she told me to come straight from work.
appearance: Rowan has heavy brows and an unusually delicate jaw. Look for dark brown curls cut close behind the ears. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a boxy denim jacket with a thin silver ring worn on a cord. In conversation Rowan folds a paper napkin into quarters without noticing.
personality: Rowan admires skill and distrusts the idea that skill gives anyone permission to be rude. Rowan learns fastest from somebody willing to show how they made a mistake.
agenda: To turn up in the work clothes the host invited.
family: Kai Chan is Rowan’s second cousin. Rowan picks the meeting place. Kai sets the time to leave. It lets them stay close without turning a family visit into the loss of an entire day. They have both had stretches when that distinction mattered. Asked about *The fountain score*, Kai says, “I sell whistles and dislike giving them away.”
connections: Hugo Paul. A visitor straight from work notices the ties inside the pockets.

reactions.situation: The diner wants to fasten the new cuff unaided
reactions.response: Rowan leaves the cuff in reach and lets the diner set the pace.

reactions.situation: An unfamiliar person asks for directions but cannot read the street signs
reactions.response: Rowan finds out what the destination actually looks like to the traveler and gives directions in those terms.
